text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Entre 2008 et 2015, Helene Budliger Artieda a tenu les rênes de la Direction des ressources au Département fédéral des affaires étrangères (DFAE)", "gist": "Helene Budliger Artieda held the position of Director of Resources at the Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs from 2008 to 2015"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Dans cette fonction, elle conseillait le chef du département pour les questions relatives aux ressources et siégeait à la direction du DFAE", "gist": "In this role, she advised the department head on resource-related matters and sat on the DFAE's management board"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "2000", "gist": "Year when Helene Budliger Artieda obtained her MBA"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Universidad Externado de Colombia, à Bogota", "gist": "University where Helene Budliger Artieda earned her MBA"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "diplôme fédéral de l’école de commerce de Zurich", "gist": "Federal diploma from the Zurich School of Commerce held by Helene Budliger Artieda"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "DFAE", "gist": "Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Elle avait suivi une formation interne au DFAE pour devenir collaboratrice consulaire", "gist": "She completed internal training at the DFAE to become a consular staff member"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Elle est mariée", "gist": "She is married"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Eric Scheidegger", "gist": "Name of a person (likely the author or subject of the text)"}]}
